rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you, that's really generous. Here's what would help most right now. We're planning a small, open evaluation project. Before choosing a target, we want to understand what's already being measured. A useful first task (a few hours): survey the existing public AI-safety eval suites and put together a simple table with name, what it measures, size, licence, and any known weaknesses. That will help us find a real gap rather than duplicate someone else's work. Later on, your analysis skills would be ideal for designing the scoring (agreement between human labellers, error bars). We're also starting a small reading group in December, and you'd be very welcome. Does that sound good? No rush at all. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: **Sent:** a reply to Priya Raman. I asked her to start by listing the AI-safety tests that already exist publicly, and invited her to the reading group.
